title: Exhaustion of an open set of ℝ^N by open sets with compact closure inside it (parent Step 2)
statement: For every N ∈ ℕ and every open set U ⊆ ℝ^N (ℝ^N = Rn N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) there is a sequence (W_i)_{i∈ℕ} of open subsets of ℝ^N such that, for every i, the closure of W_i is compact and contained in U, and ⋃_{i∈ℕ} W_i = U.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)), IsOpen U → ∃ W : ℕ → Set (Rn N), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ IsCompact (closure (W i)) ∧ closure (W i) ⊆ U) ∧ ⋃ i, W i = U
